question: Will the 10-year minus 3-month U.S. Treasury par yield spread (Treasury daily par yield curve, percentage points) for 2024-10-13 (or the last business day before it with a published reading) be above -1.25 pp, its value for 2024-07-12?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2024-07-15 (2024-07-12), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
